description: Browse the embedded runnable examples. Without `slug`: the JSONL metadata index (`slug` · `form` · `one_line` · `cost`). With `slug`: that example's full workflow source — read the canonical example instead of guessing a construct. With `builtin`: the examples that call one `nika:*` tool.

builtin.description: A builtin name (`nika:jq` or bare `jq`) — one JSONL row per example that calls it (`slug` · `builtin` · `one_line` · `sites`). Read a precedent for a tool's args instead of guessing them.

slug.description: An example slug from the list (e.g. `pr-risk-review`).

name: nika_examples
title: Browse runnable examples
